messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: starting a phased rollout for telemetry sampling consent in the Python SDK. Goal: respect user consent flags, avoid surprising quota attribution, and add a console toggle for 'consent-aware sampling'.
kevin: high-level question: opt-in or opt-out for existing customers?
sarah: UX suggestion: keep current behavior for existing installs (i.e., default to previous telemetry), expose a migration flag + callout in console labeled 'consent-aware sampling (beta)'.
maria: agreed. New SDKs will accept telemetry_sampling values and default new installs to 'consent' while existing installs remain unchanged. Server will support an `X-RW-TELEMETRY-CONSENT` header for explicit intent.
tim: can you paste the proposed client API so we can align go/ts too?
maria: example snippet:
```python
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), telemetry_sampling='consent')
# valid: 'always' | 'none' | 'consent'
```
josh: how will this affect quota accounting? If telemetry is suppressed we risk undercounting and misattribution. Console/backfill needed.
sarah: Console plan: show 'estimated' attribution when coverage <100%. We will add a 'telemetry coverage' metric on tenant overview and a toggle to hide estimated data.
kevin: infra question: standardized header name please. Proposal: `X-RW-TELEMETRY-CONSENT: consent|no-consent|always`. Server treats absence as legacy behavior (telemetry sent).
maria: accepted. SDKs will set header when telemetry_sampling != 'always'. Server will also offer an enterprise override flag.
tim: compatibility note: older SDKs won't send header; server should preserve existing telemetry behavior for absent header. Confirm?
maria: yes. Absence => telemetry preserved. New behavior only when SDK/env explicitly sets it. Env var: `RW_TELEMETRY_SAMPLING=consent`.
josh: ops concern: per-tenant protections use detailed telemetry. If coverage drops, we need fallback to protect platform.
kevin: infra reply: implement a smoothing heuristic: if >5% of requests in a tenant window lack telemetry for 1h, put tenant into conservative rate limiting until reconciliation. Thresholds TBC.
sarah: dashboard: show 'telemetry coverage: 87% (estimated)'. Add a visual flag for when attribution is estimated and an exportable CSV noting estimated rows.
maria: rollout stages: 1) canary SDK build with header & env var; server accepts header but no enforcement. 2) console preview tile for opt-in and estimated attribution. 3) enable opt-in default for new installs only. 4) add account-wide enterprise knob. Timeline: three weeks to canary, then slow ramp.
deploy-bot: py-sdk 1.14.0-canary deployed to canary orgs at 2026-03-23T15:02:00Z
tim: will draft migration guide in devex docs, update changelog, and add tests: header present, header absent, server fallback case. Also add CI lint to detect boolean telemetry usage.
maria: on deprecation: we have some helpers using a boolean `telemetry` param. Will change to string enum; emit DeprecationWarning at import if boolean used and provide shim for two releases.
kevin: strong +1 on lint rule to avoid silent breakage.
josh: support asks to draft admin email template for accounts flipped by enterprise admins. I'll coordinate with Sarah.
sarah: I'll draft dashboard copy and the email.
kevin: legal: double-check TOS impact for customers switching telemetry semantics.
maria: adding legal to the thread.
tim: engineering tasks: SDK change, go/ts parity, server header acceptance, infra smoothing guard, console telemetry coverage view, tests + e2e that simulates suppressed telemetry and verifies estimated attribution shows.
maria: I'll open a tracking GH epic and link PRs. Posting canary link + draft migration doc into #devex-resources after this thread.
kevin: approved. No blockers from eng-platform; will coordinate final header name and enterprise flag semantics.
maria: thanks everyone. Will post follow-ups and the PRs shortly.
